description:
Turn an anchored hash into a readable certificate with a public page: title, owner, fingerprint, block
and time. Useful as dated evidence for designs, drafts, contracts and research notes. The hash must already
be anchored and confirmed (anchor_hashes).

description.description: Optional sentence shown on the certificate
description.title: Description

owner.description: Person or company the certificate is made out to
owner.title: Owner

title.description: What the file is, e.g. 'Bracket A-12 drawing rev C'
title.title: Title

name: anchor_certificate
title: Proof-of-existence certificate
